results.title: What is K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm in Data Science?
results.content: # What is K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm in Data Science? k nearest neighbors is quoted as one of the most important algorithms in machine learning in data science. Understanding the k-nearest neighbor algorithm begins with understanding data science; you can get an insight into the same through our Data Science training. Learning by analogy is at the heart of nearest-neighbor classifiers; they do this by comparing a given test tuple to training tuples that are similar to it. These k "*nearest neighbors*" of the unknown tuple are used for training. In this scenario, the classifier estimates the unknown tuple by averaging the real-valued labels of the k nearest neighbors. The distance matrix is a crucial component in the k-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm, which aims to classify new data points based on their proximity to existing labeled data points. ### **Uses For K Nearest Neighbor Algorithm In Machine Learning**.
